The '''Guard Navy''' was the [[Navy/Legends|naval]] arm of the [[Mecetti House Guard]]. The [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] consisted of twelve [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], the majority of which were [[Victory II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory II''-class Star Destroyers]]. The [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] were bought from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] second-hand and refurbished at the [[Obulette shipyards]]. The rest of the fleet was comprised of dozens of [[Picket ship/Legends|picket ships]], [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]], [[Assault boat/Legends|assault boats]], and [[Snubfighter/Legends|snubfighters]].<ref name="LE" />
